answer: Reaching eligibility takes 33 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an copycat pays for every seat it wants. The zephyr register is checked at draw time, vertex lists the eligible set, and umber seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 33 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. The fee repeats 18 times over. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
